Title: Azure Lab Services now has an updated UI experience

Body.Content:
Azure Lab Services now has an updated UI experience. Some key improvements include: 

  • A cleaner visual look.  
  • An improved lab creation experience. 
  • An improved template page experience. 
  • Search functionality for labs and lab accounts. 
  • Sorting and filtering functionality on users and virtual machine pool pages. 

Start using the new experience today and let us know what you think by providing feedback at the feedback forum. 

If you have questions, go to Stack Overflow.

Learn more
